title: One standards skill routes every repo to the query tool (S11)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S11 (Sector 3 — Retrieval (ADR 0020; items 1–3)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0020 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
Outcome: the `standards` skill is the same file in KRN and adopted repos; per-language prose skills are harvested into records and removed; the pull stop rule is measured after 2 weeks
Files: see ADR 0020 Consequences.
Proof: `bin/krn adopt --refresh . --dry-run: no drift`
Predicted: metric query-calls-per-session >= 0.2
After: S10
